    if (X[15] == 1'b0 && Y[15] == 1'b1) begin
        result <= 3'b100;
    end
    else if (X[15] == 1'b1 && Y[15] == 1'b0) begin
        result <= 3'b010;
    end

        if (X[9:0] < Y[9:0]) begin
            result <= 3'b100;
        end
        else if (X[9:0] > Y[9:0]) begin
            result <= 3'b010;
        end
        else begin
            result <= 3'b001;
        end
    end
    else begin
        result <= 3'b000;
    end
end
endmodule
